title: Majority tail bound
statement: For every integer $m\ge 0$ and real $C\ge 0$ such that $C/\sqrt{2m+1}\le 1/2$, let $X$ be a uniformly independent sign vector of length $2m+1$ whose coordinates equal $-1$ with probability $p=1/2-C/\sqrt{2m+1}$. The probability that the majority of the coordinates is $-1$ is at most $2\exp(-2C^2)$.
